response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and AI-agent infrastructure experience, particularly in TypeScript, Node.js, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) frameworks, aligning well with the role's technical requirements. However, his AI/GenAI experience is less explicitly detailed than ideal for a Staff-level position, and his cloud infrastructure work appears secondary to his broader software development background.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and modern AI-agent tooling (e.g., MCP code generators).
Proven technical leadership in customer-facing roles, including mentoring and driving engineering excellence.
Diverse project portfolio with open-source contributions and hands-on experience in data pipelines and real-time systems.
concerns: AI/GenAI experience is not as prominently detailed as required for a Staff-level role in this domain.
Cloud platform expertise (AWS/GCP/Azure) is implied but not explicitly highlighted in production-grade AI contexts.
Lacks explicit mention of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM optimization techniques in recent roles.
